decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts build directly on the firm's core glass structuring, drilling and bonding know-how, and its own R&D plus EU project experience let it interpret early market feedback and refine the product for MEMS packaging customers.

Carrier wafers for handling smaller diameter wafers are a close extension of the firm's established carrier and thin-wafer handling offer, so the firm can readily assimilate customer learning at low cost, and the product fits its strategic push toward reusable carriers.
